question: Subaru was pretending to be insane in Arc 3, but since Crusch-san has the Divine Protection of Wind Reading, didn’t she see through his act?
answer: If Subaru was doing that thinking “Good, good, if I pretend to be crazy here, I can get away with it, hehehe”, he might have gotten caught, but he wasn’t trying to fool anyone by acting crazy, and if nothing is said, then no lies have been told, and if Crusch-san tried to talk with someone who you could look at and say “Ah, a madman!”, Feris would have said “You mustn’t get near that sort” and stopped her, so Crusch-sama has never actually read the wind coming from a mad person.
